description: Two needle meters in the style of the EMS Synthi's VU meter, each reading one signal against a dial marked -5 to +5 and 0 to 10

params.text: Switches that meter's dial between the 0-10V scale and the -5V to 5V scale
The averaging time of that meter's reading, from 4ms to 1000ms

menu: Show Big Value in Meters — prints the reading as a number on the dial
Remove Glass from Meters — draws the dial without the glass over it
Draw needle in white — draws the needle in white instead of black
